name: qkd_kvwq_leaf_s_w129_m-sl1-4df79ee4f
purpose: Qwen ROM TP8 contract v3 slot cell qkd_kvwq_leaf_s_w129_m (128 instances, slots wleaf_<q>_<pc>): first view under the die master name with the die's own buses c/n/dn/dp/w/wr/lane (the closed route qkd_kvwq_leaf_s_w129_m-b90ad2fab of the same body was exported as cell ot_qkvd_kv_wq_leaf with RTL port names and cannot bind). Body = ot_qkvd_kv_wq_leaf unchanged (every port a flop at its pin); wrapper = wiring only, buses packed LSB first in kv_die BINDINGS order. Outline 129.6 x 183.6, pins M5 (N/S) / M4 (E), clock ck on N, cap M5.
